title: Battle of Verneuil
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Verneuil", at revision 1382310759, opens: "The Battle of Verneuil was a battle of the Hundred Years' War, fought on 17 August 1424 near Verneuil-sur-Avre in Normandy between an English army and a combined Franco-Scottish force, augmented by Milanese heavy cavalry. The battle was a significant English victory, and was described by them as a second Agincourt." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q425617, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1424 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
